description.narrative: Integrated Health Outreach is an organization that works at the intersection of gender, the environment, and health. They aim to promote and facilitate environmental, mental, and emotional well-being, by providing support to the most underserved and excluded in society. Through research and education, the organization's long-term commitment is to develop and implement sustainable, cost-effective, and accessible programs. Targeting and strengthening resiliency, community capacity, and eco-sustainability, their goal is to empower the socially vulnerable and excluded. The grant will support the following specific priorities: - Organizational costs such as staff salaries, consultant fees for organizational development, auditing fees, organizational training and capacity strengthening, internet, electricity, phone data, software, and others; - Meeting/ workshop-related costs such as transportation, meals, venue rental, materials, and others.
